nodes.notes: No retry on purpose: a mutation that reached Open Collective and timed out must not be sent twice. A failure releases the claim and the person tries again.

nodes.name: Post the private note
nodes.notes: The decision has already landed, so a failed note is reported in the thread and never undoes it. The note always carries who decided, even when the dialog's note field was empty.

nodes.name: Release the claim
nodes.notes: The one claim that is ever cleared, and only by the run that stamped it. The saved email stays: if Open Collective did decide despite the error, apply 1a or 1b sends the email the person wrote, and decision_email_for keeps it from going out with the other decision.
